fee_rule: the fee of a transaction is the fee rate times the larger of its fee mass (the mass a node charges its fee floor on) and the storage mass a node calculates for it, both read from that very transaction

probes.name: B1 transfer without the owner's signature
probes.what: Alice's 10 tokens are moved to Bob with a witness signed by Bob's key, not Alice's

probes.name: B2 more tokens out than in
probes.what: Alice signs a transfer of her 3-token coin into 3 tokens for herself and 1 for Bob: 4 out of 3

probes.name: B3 the seed creates a coin that already holds tokens
probes.what: the issuer's seed creates a token coin for Bob that holds 5 tokens nobody minted

steps.name: 01 launch

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 25 left to mint

steps.what: the issuer's coin creates the minter (25 to mint, at most 10 per mint) and the seed

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 25 left to mint

steps.name: 02 mint

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 15 left to mint

steps.what: the minter mints 10 tokens to Alice

steps.name: 03 transfer
steps.what: Alice moves 4 tokens to Bob and keeps 6 (one coin in, two out)

steps.name: 04 seed create

outputs.what: token coin of Bob: 0 tokens, open to payments

steps.what: the seed creates a zero-token coin for Bob, open to payments (threshold 0)

spends.what: token coin of Bob: 0 tokens, open to payments

steps.name: 05 borrowed receive

outputs.what: token coin of Bob: 3 tokens, open to payments

steps.what: Alice pays 3 tokens into Bob's open coin; Bob does not sign

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 15 left to mint

steps.name: 06 minter split

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 10 left to mint
minter of Bob: 5 left to mint

steps.what: the minter hands 5 of its 15 to a new minter owned by Bob

spends.what: minter of Bob: 5 left to mint

steps.name: 07 mint from the split

outputs.what: minter of Bob: 3 left to mint

steps.what: Bob's minter mints 2 tokens to Bob

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 10 left to mint
minter of Bob: 3 left to mint

steps.name: 08 reclaim into

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 13 left to mint

steps.what: Bob's minter (3 left) retires into the issuer's minter; Bob signs and gets the deposit

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 13 left to mint

steps.name: 09 mint

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 3 left to mint

steps.what: the minter mints 10 tokens to Alice

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 3 left to mint

steps.name: 10 last mint

outputs.what: minter of the issuer: 0 left to mint

steps.what: the minter mints its last 3 tokens to Bob

spends.what: minter of the issuer: 0 left to mint

steps.name: 11 minter reclaim
steps.what: the issuer closes the empty minter and gets the deposit

steps.name: 12 seed split
steps.what: the seed creates a second seed owned by Bob

steps.name: 13 seed reclaim
steps.what: Bob's seed is closed next to the issuer's; Bob signs and gets the deposit
